plan.action_summary: A silent, hands-and-forearm-only macro: the right hand draws one smooth diagonal maroon stroke on the inner left forearm with the uncapped crayon, then lifts the crayon slightly off the skin.
script_requirements: Silent clip. No face, no speech, no lip movement. Any voiceover is added later in the edit and is never acted out.
45-degree macro on the left forearm resting inner side up on cream silk, warm lamp light from frame-left.
Exactly one stroke, about 5 cm long, drawn left to right on a clean forearm. No second stroke, no blending, no rubbing.
Keep the crayon one consistent size and shape: black body, maroon tip, uncapped, cap not in frame.
plan.start_pose: Left forearm lies flat, inner side up, on cream silk; skin bare and dry. Right hand holds the uncapped crayon like a pencil, tip about 1 cm above the inner forearm, left end of the stroke area. Deep-maroon almond nails visible on the right hand.
plan.end_pose: One clean maroon diagonal stroke on the forearm. Crayon lifted about 2 cm above the skin at the right end of the stroke. Left arm unmoved.

steps.what_happens: The crayon tip lowers and touches the skin at the left start point.
steps.right_hand: Pencil grip: thumb and index pinch the body, middle finger supports underneath, ring and little fingers curled. Lower slowly with a small wrist tilt.
steps.left_hand: Forearm completely still and relaxed, fingers softly curled and out of the way.
steps.contact_and_grip: Only the crayon tip touches the skin; no other fingertip or knuckle touches the arm.
steps.object_changes: Skin is bare until the tip lands. No colour before contact.
steps.physics: Tip meets skin with light pressure; the skin dimples very slightly.
steps.natural_detail: A tiny pre-contact hover and settle, as a real hand finds its spot.

steps.what_happens: One smooth diagonal stroke is drawn left to right, leaving a continuous maroon line behind the tip.
steps.right_hand: Wrist and forearm glide as one unit; fingers keep the same grip. Constant, even pressure, no re-grip.
steps.contact_and_grip: Tip stays on the skin the whole stroke; the line appears only behind the tip.
steps.object_changes: The maroon line grows with the tip and stays one solid colour, about 5 cm, never branching.
steps.physics: Creamy pigment deposits as a slightly glossy line, matte once it settles.
steps.natural_detail: A faint ease-in at the start and ease-out at the end of the stroke.

steps.what_happens: The crayon lifts off the skin, pausing just above the finished stroke.
steps.right_hand: Lift with the wrist, grip unchanged. Hold still for the last frames; no wipe or second pass.
steps.object_changes: The stroke is unchanged; the crayon shows no extra wear.
steps.physics: The hand slows to a stop without a snap.
steps.natural_detail: A slight settle of the lifted wrist, then stillness so the swatch reads clearly.

plan.product_result: One clean, even maroon swatch is clearly visible on the forearm.
forbidden_mistakes: No face or head in frame.
Two hands at most, each attached to its own forearm, five digits each, no fused or extra fingers.
Exactly one stroke. No second stroke, smudge, rub or blend.
The crayon stays one size, shape and colour; the cap never appears.
Colour appears only behind the tip after contact, never before.
No text, logo or label is generated on the product other than what the reference shows.
No flames, no phone, no extra objects entering the frame.
plan.duration_fit: Three consecutive steps cover exactly 0-3 s: 0.8 s touch-down, 1.4 s stroke, 0.8 s lift and hold.
